# Sugar & Leather

> Human at the core, unbreakable under pressure. World-class executive coaching and strategic AI leadership for people and organizations leading through change.

Sugar & Leather unites capital, leadership, and execution in one ecosystem built for sustainable growth.

## Ecosystem

- [Capital Access & Grant Services](https://sugarandleather.com/capital-access): Grants, incentives, and non-dilutive funding with operational readiness for long-term growth.
- [Strategic CXO team](https://sugarandleather.com/strategic-partnerships): Executive leadership and specialized pods that help execute growth initiatives.
- [Community](https://sugarandleather.com/community): Learning communities for coaches, founders, and emerging entrepreneurs.
- [Aries Platform](https://sugarandleather.com/aries-platform): Innovation and technology within the Sugar & Leather ecosystem.
- [Advanced Tech](https://sugarandleather.com/advanced-tech): Research initiatives and advanced technology programs.
- [Innovation & Advanced Tech](https://sugarandleather.ai/): External research and advanced technology hub.

## Strategic CXO team pods

- [Marketing Pod](https://sugarandleather.com/strategic-partnerships/marketing-pod): Demand, brand, and marketing operations.
- [Sales Pod](https://sugarandleather.com/strategic-partnerships/sales-pod): Revenue systems and commercial execution.
- [Development Pod](https://sugarandleather.com/strategic-partnerships/development-pod): Product, systems, and scalable technology.
- [Recruitment Pod](https://sugarandleather.com/strategic-partnerships/recruitment-pod): Talent strategy and hiring for growth.
